-- Phase 35 Migration: Guided AI Experience tables
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS contextual_help_items (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  workspace_id INT NOT NULL,
  page_key VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  help_type ENUM('tooltip', 'article', 'faq', 'walkthrough') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'tooltip',
  title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  content TEXT NOT NULL,
  target_selector VARCHAR(255),
  display_order INT DEFAULT 0,
  is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lifecycle_status_history (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  workspace_id INT NOT NULL,
  record_type VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  record_id INT NOT NULL,
  from_status VARCHAR(100),
  to_status VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  changed_by INT,
  change_reason TEXT,
  metadata TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS auto_population_events (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  workspace_id INT NOT NULL,
  source_type VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  source_record_type VARCHAR(100),
  source_record_id INT,
  target_record_type VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  target_record_id INT NOT NULL,
  fields_applied TEXT NOT NULL,
  status ENUM('applied', 'accepted', 'rejected', 'partial') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'applied',
  applied_by INT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS source_references (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  workspace_id INT NOT NULL,
  record_type VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  record_id INT NOT NULL,
  field_name VARCHAR(100),
  source_type VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  source_location VARCHAR(255),
  source_excerpt TEXT,
  confidence DECIMAL(5,2),
  verified BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
  verified_by INT,
  verified_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS contract_deliverables_v2 (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  workspace_id INT NOT NULL,
  contract_id INT NOT NULL,
  title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  cdrl_number VARCHAR(50),
  frequency VARCHAR(100),
  due_date TIMESTAMP NULL,
  status ENUM('pending', 'in_progress', 'submitted', 'accepted', 'rejected') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  source_finding_id INT,
  assigned_to INT,
  notes TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS template_improvement_suggestions (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  workspace_id INT NOT NULL,
  source_type VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  source_record_id INT,
  template_type VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  suggestion_text TEXT NOT NULL,
  priority ENUM('low', 'medium', 'high') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium',
  status ENUM('new', 'accepted', 'rejected', 'implemented') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new',
  created_by INT,
  reviewed_by INT,
  reviewed_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);
description: Phase 35: Create new tables for contextual help, lifecycle history, auto-population, source references, contract deliverables v2, and template improvement suggestions
